preamble: Retraction of the alveolo-palatal fricative [ɕ] to the retroflex fricative [ʂ]. In the history of Mandarin, the Middle Chinese palatal sibilant series (the 章 initials, including the fricative 書 [ɕ]) merged with the retroflex series, so that Middle Chinese [ɕ] is continued as Mandarin sh [ʂ].

examples.note: Same change before a different rhyme.
